title: Cynara scolymus tincture for medicinal use
intro: Cynara scolymus tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the leaves of the artichoke plant, which is known for its medicinal properties. This preparation is commonly used in herbalism to support liver health and detoxification due to its high content of compounds like cynarin. It is often recommended for individuals seeking to improve digestion and reduce inflammation in the gastrointestinal tract. The tincture can be taken internally in small doses, typically diluted in water or another liquid. Its bitter taste is believed to stimulate digestive enzymes and enhance overall metabolic function.
